evidence.reason: Valid minor test-coverage defect. The test name and comment claim a digest mismatch refuses before helper import, but the body only runs the CLI with an invalid --sha and then checks the refusal error, absence of lock/record artifacts, and unchanged HEAD. None of those assertions observe whether prepare-host.py was imported; an implementation that imported the helper and then rejected the digest before preflight would still pass. The matching-digest test remains the success control. Instrument the helper import and require zero calls on mismatch.
